gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Commanding and a little menacing, Bloody throws its rounded lowercase forward like a shout. Noto Sans Tagalog is the quiet counterweight, with a dense middle band and generously open curves.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Bloody's swollen, rounded lowercase is the first thing you notice. Make it small and the menace shrinks to a smudge, while Noto Sans Tagbanwa fills its lines with open curves and modern, clean letters.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Bloody comes in loud and rounded, a display face with a threat. Noto Sans Tai Tham settles a long read down, its lowercase pressing up toward the capital line while each c stays clearly open.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Loud, round and slightly sinister, that's Bloody. Noto Sans Tai Viet follows in a plain sans manner, with short ascenders, lofty lowercase bodies and pulled-back terminals that keep a long page approachable.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-takri: Bloody swaggers in with rounded, commanding lowercase, a display face that wants every eye in the room. Noto Sans Takri holds the line with open-curved, high-waisted sans-serif letters.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Contemporary in attitude but menacing in shape, Bloody swells its rounded lowercase into something you can't ignore. Noto Sans Tamil, a sans-serif that looks magnified, lets its terminals stop short of the stem.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Bloody's inflated, round lowercase is pure menace. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement offers the plain sans counter-move: rounded forms like open parentheses, and a middle band so deep the line looks stocky.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Approachable is not a word Bloody would use, since it prefers rounded, commanding lowercase that dominates a headline. And Noto Sans Tangsa is a sans-serif that does the welcoming, with wide-open round letters and short ascender stems.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-tc: Bloody's inflated, rounded lowercase gives the heading a bloody, commanding bite. Noto Sans TC handles the quieter job as a sans-serif, with large open counters and curves that flare outward rather than curling in.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Noto Sans Thai Looped reads clean and bold-looking, its lofty lowercase bodies leaving spacious gaps at every curve terminal. Shrink Bloody and its menace fades.
